data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘faahimah’, meaning 'she who guides or leads'. In Islamic tradition, this name is often given to girls as a symbol of spiritual guidance and leadership. The name Fahimat carries the meaning “Guide, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fahimat usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahimat total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
